recommended_actions_by_class.High-energy Discharge: Immediate engineering review and controlled shutdown planning.
recommended_actions_by_class.High-temperature Overheating: Plan urgent inspection, thermal verification, and load reduction review.
recommended_actions_by_class.Partial Discharge: Schedule insulation-focused diagnostic inspection and intensified monitoring.
recommended_actions_by_class.Low-energy Discharge: Inspect bushings, connections, and repeat DGA in the near term.
recommended_actions_by_class.Medium-temperature Overheating: Plan maintenance outage and investigate cooling or contact resistance issues.
recommended_actions_by_class.Low-temperature Overheating: Monitor trend and schedule routine inspection if repeated.
